analysis: b-04 tested force and mass, concepts this chapter never defines; rewrote it as an average-speed check grounded in claim-05 (100 m covered in 20 s gives 5 m/s). Every number is copied verbatim from the source material.

spec.question: A runner covers 100 m in 20 s. What is her average speed (in m/s)?
spec.explanation: Average speed is total distance divided by total time: 100 m covered in 20 s gives 5 m/s.
spec.expected_understanding: The learner can compute average speed from total distance and total time.
